question: How have the frontier labs' published safety frameworks (Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy, OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework) changed since their first versions, and which changes tightened versus loosened the commitments?
claim: Anthropic RSP v3.0 (Feb 2026) removed the pause commitment requiring halts when capability thresholds crossed but safeguards not ready, per comparativeai.org and hirenest.ai reports.

claims.claim: Anthropic RSP v3.0 (Feb 2026) removed the pause commitment requiring halts when capability thresholds crossed but safeguards not ready, per comparativeai.org and hirenest.ai reports.
OpenAI Preparedness Framework update (April 2025) introduced 'stronger requirements for what it means to sufficiently minimize' catastrophic risks.
Anthropic published 9 RSP versions Sep 2023-July 2026; only 1 substantive change publicly documented (pause removal), rest lack detailed changelogs comparing commitments.
DeepMind published 4 Frontier Safety Framework versions May 2024-April 2026 with no specific change documentation beyond general statements about 'lessons learned.'
